title: I made a game inspired by Pikmin, RTS games, and Family Time where you throw your people at all your problems
author: ryry1237
selftext:
Made this mainly with Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 (Fable 5.2 came out a little after I already had most of the changes in). Could not have done all the optimizations needed to get +5000 units to run on a phone without Claude. I always wanted another Pikmin game where you could literally throw your people at problems and they'd figure out a way to solve it on their own. The hardest things though surprisingly weren't the graphics or performance anymore, but more invisible things like level design and gameplay pacing which don't exactly show up in this video (but trust me that's what took 80% of the time and tokens).

Not sure about self promotion rules, but the game is free and there's a link to it in my bio.
